description: Automated dependency updates (audit item 26). Before this, no automation existed and majors accumulated (astro 6→7, vite 7→8) with a CI audit-job esbuild ignore waiting on a bump nothing was driving.

packageRules.description: Batch all non-major updates into one weekly PR
Majors ride separate PRs, one per package family
